text: From limited preparation time to scoring 99% and securing a Top 2% position in NPTEL's Internet, Crimes and Cyber Security course. A story about smart preparation, previous-year questions, consistency and confidence.

Behind every SaaS product are late-night debugging sessions, broken deployments, API failures and scaling challenges. SummerSaaS 2026 was an experience of collaboration, experimentation, problem-solving and building real products.
Excited to begin the SaaSum AI Track at SummerSaaS 2026. Exploring how Generative AI can unify fragmented enterprise systems, automate workflows and solve real-world business challenges.

I stopped posting, but I didn't stop learning. After completing a 14-day AI Image Annotation internship, I learned how accurate data labeling directly impacts AI model performance. Growth doesn't always have to be loud.

What if AI misdiagnoses an MRI? Exploring a Human-in-the-Loop AI diagnostic system using CNNs, confidence-based review thresholds, Grad-CAM explainability and human validation. AI should assist doctors, not replace them.

Attended an Amazon WoW session on the SDET role. Learned how software development engineers in test connect development and testing, explored career paths and understood the importance of test automation.
Excited to enter India's Summer AI Hackathon. With thousands of teams and participants, the focus is on building real products, solving problems and turning ideas into working prototypes.
